title: Generator form of the diffusion chain rule
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Eq. (2.2.15) immediately after Definition 2.2.13: equivalently, the diffusion chain rule can be stated as L(phi∘f)=phi'(f)Lf+phi''(f)Gamma(f) on the relevant operator/Gamma domain. Definition 2.2.13 quantifies over all scalar maps phi : R -> R and does not explicitly impose a global ContDiff hypothesis; the paper derivative notation is made explicit in Lean by named first/second derivative fields with pointwise HasDerivAt witnesses. Chewi leaves the equivalence with Eq. (2.2.14) to Exercise 2.8.
target_statement: Introduce an explicit-domain generator-form diffusion chain-rule interface with arbitrary scalar phi and explicit derivative fields phiPrime, phiSecond: closure under phi∘f and L(phi∘f)=phiPrime(f)Lf+phiSecond(f)Gamma(f,f), under pointwise HasDerivAt witnesses for phi and phiPrime. Do not claim or prove equivalence with the Gamma-chain-rule interface from PR #219 in this cell.

shared_floor_audit.notes: Chewi presents Eq. (2.2.15) as equivalent to the Gamma scalar-composition chain rule but leaves that equivalence to Exercise 2.8. This cell therefore formalizes Eq. (2.2.15) as its own explicit property rather than deriving it from PR #219. A previous draft silently strengthened the source to ContDiff R top phi. Re-reading Definition 2.2.13 shows that the definition instead quantifies over all phi : R -> R and writes phi' / phi'' directly, so the current interface mirrors #219 and represents those derivative fields with pointwise HasDerivAt witnesses. Earlier evidence for the superseded ContDiff statement is not used. The exact corrected head passed both focused and root gates. Exercise 2.8 equivalence remains a separate formal gap.
